page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A4.Ax.Flex.4-64 is an Arm64 compute shape based on the Ampere AmpereOne-M processor architecture. The instance configuration allocates 8 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, exposing 8 vCPUs without simultaneous multithreading. Paired with the processor subsystem is 64.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8.0 GB per core ratio designed for memory-intensive computational profiles.

The instance does not bundle local disk storage, requiring external cloud block volumes for the root filesystem and persistent application data. Graphical acceleration is absent, with zero GPUs present. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. The dedicated nature of the single-threaded Arm cores delivers predictable execution, avoiding performance degradation from hyperthread contention while optimizing operational cost efficiency for high-memory configurations.

VM.Standard.A4.Ax.Flex.4-64 is suitable for workloads requiring significant memory allocations alongside predictable processor performance. Primary use cases include in-memory key-value stores, distributed database nodes, ETL data transformation jobs, web application serving, and continuous integration pipelines targeted at 64-bit Arm environments.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A4.Ax.Flex.4-64 is an Arm-based instance configured with an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio. The server provides 8 dedicated physical cores operating on the Ampere AmpereOne-M architecture, providing 8 vCPUs with a single thread per core to prevent multithreading contention. It is provisioned with 64.0 GB of system memory, supplying 8.0 GB of RAM per core for memory-intensive tasks. The configuration excludes local disk storage, relying on attached cloud block storage, and features no GPU acceleration. One complimentary public IPv4 address is provided. The dedicated core allocation and generous RAM capacity deliver predictable throughput and cost efficiency for non-accelerated computing. VM.Standard.A4.Ax.Flex.4-64 is suited for in-memory databases, caching layers, analytics runtimes, web application servers, and Arm64 build infrastructure.
